description: River flood status and forecast — River flooding near a point or at one gauge from NOAA's National Water Prediction Service. With lat= & lon= (radius_mi= 5-100, default 25; limit=): every river gauge in range with observed stage/flow, flood category (no flooding, action, minor, moderate, major) and forecast category, sorted worst first, plus a verdict. With gauge= (NWS LID, e.g. NAST1): flood-stage thresholds, current stage with 6h/24h trend, official forecast crest and category, feet below the next threshold, impact statements at that level and the next, and top historic crests. Public domain. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_river_flood
